module.name: holoscan-pcl-filters
module.description: Point-cloud filters on the GPU for organized or unorganized XYZ clouds with optional colors, in holoscan-point-cloud's layout: a deterministic voxel grid (centroid or first point, mean colors), a crop box and pass-through or range filter with an optional transform, RANSAC ground removal with the plane's coefficients (or a height threshold), and statistical or radius outlier removal over a GPU grid. Clouds stay organized, removed points NaN, or come out packed.

hardware.name: NVIDIA GPU
hardware.description: A CUDA-capable GPU supported by the Holoscan SDK.
